ra: Maitreya (the Christ/World Teacher) heads the teaching department of the Spiritual Hierarchy under Sanat Kumara.
The Manu heads the will/government department of the Spiritual Hierarchy.
The Buddhas of Activity belong to the planetary hierarchy at Shamballa, assisting Sanat Kumara.
The Solar Angel is a soul-order mediator within the broader Theosophical hierarchy.
The Master Jesus is one of the named Masters of Wisdom (sixth-ray).
The Master Saint Germain (Rakoczi) is the seventh-ray Chohan among the Masters of Wisdom.
The Master Hilarion is the fifth-ray Chohan among the Masters of Wisdom.
The Master Serapis Bey is the fourth-ray Chohan among the Masters of Wisdom.
Sanat Kumara, the Lord of the World, dwells at Shamballa, the highest planetary spiritual centre.
Bailey's 'the Christ' (Maitreya) is the cosmic principle that overshadowed Jesus; a modern functional cognate of the canonical Christ.
The Master Jesus is the disciple-vehicle whom 'the Christ' overshadowed; functionally linked to the canonical Jesus while held distinct.
As the World Teacher embodying the love-wisdom principle, Maitreya presides over wisdom.
As the soul/higher-self mediator, the Solar Angel governs access to inner esoteric knowledge.
The Seven Rays are the energy qualities conditioning all esoteric structure in Bailey's system.
As fifth-ray Chohan of concrete knowledge and science, Hilarion presides over knowledge.
As seventh-ray Chohan of ceremonial order and magic, Saint Germain presides over magic.
Lucifer is one of the three classes constituting Steiner's threefold adversary powers.
Ahriman is one of the three classes constituting Steiner's threefold adversary powers.
The Asuras are the third and most dangerous class within Steiner's threefold adversary powers.
Steiner adopted the name and adversarial role of his Ahriman from the Zoroastrian Angra Mainyu (Ahriman).
Steiner's Lucifer is a re-conception named after, but not identical to, the Christian fallen-angel Lucifer.
Steiner's Sun-Demon Sorat takes its name and 666 solar association from the Agrippan solar spirit Sorath.
Steiner's Sorat functions as the Beast/Antichrist being opposing the Sun-Christ.
The Representative of Humanity is Steiner's interpretation of the Christ / Sun-Being, identified with Jesus Christ.
The Representative of Humanity holds the central balance against the upward, inflating pull of Lucifer.
The Representative of Humanity holds the central balance against the downward, materializing pull of Ahriman.
Ahriman governs the deceptive lure of pure materialism and the reduction of the spiritual to the mechanical.
Sorat as the Sun-Demon and Beast embodies an annihilating, anti-Christ destructive force.
Lucifer governs the deceptive temptations of pride, illusion, and false/inflated spirituality.
The Doorkeeper is a specialized protective role within the broader class of spirit guides.
Spirit guides are discarnate dead understood to abide in the Summerland spirit world between communications.
The Doorkeeper's defining function is protective gatekeeping over which spirits may approach a medium.
Spirit guides function to disclose messages and knowledge from the dead to the living through mediums.
The Summerland is the Spiritualist realm of the dead, the post-mortem destination of the soul.
